name: @workspace/tools-host
description: The host contract of the tools (D14): ToolHost and its defaults that need no host, the tool's description type, and the shared hooks — the tool history (D17): a tool asks its host for the history of its own id and records through it; and per-tool settings: a tool reads and follows its own entry (the first setting: copy automatically after generating), with a contract suite every implementation runs.
